text:
The abstract describes evaluating CMIP6 GCM performance and interdependency using a multivariable integrated evaluation method, ranking models, and clustering to identify relatively independent, well‑performing models. It does not assert that a novel framework employing area‑weighted scores, MISS, Pearson correlation, Kolmogorov‑Smirnov tests, and historically‑derived weights—cross‑validated against observations—will markedly improve model selection. Hence, the candidate hypothesis extends beyond what the study’s evidence actually supports.

VERDICT: REJECT
